title: Jieqi, nearby, ended early: a dealt game filed as it stood
why: Filing a dealt game is filing its deal: the three members that make the record checkable stay in the document, and the wire session that held the fourth is deleted with the game, because a row naming a peer's device has no purpose past the game it belonged to. The replay the History record opens as re-verifies the deal against the start it spells with nothing but the document to do it from. Its bytes are the corpus's jieqi-nearby-ended-early golden.
